title: AUTOMATION TEST ONLY — close without merging

questions.stem: Automation test fixture (do not publish): An oncoming school bus is loading children on a road with one travel lane each way and a shared center left-turn lane. Which action should you take?
questions.hint: Identify the condition that changes the rule, then rule out the alternatives.

choices.text: Stop; traffic in both directions must stop.
choices.feedback: One travel lane in each direction plus a center turn lane is the handbook’s two-lane-with-center-turn-lane configuration. Both directions must stop.

choices.text: Proceed because any center turn lane creates an exception.
choices.feedback: The center-turn-lane exception for opposing traffic requires four or more ordinary travel lanes.

choices.text: Stop only if the bus is in the center lane.
choices.feedback: The bus’s exact lane is not the deciding factor; this road configuration requires both directions to stop.

choices.text: Proceed slowly after sounding the horn.
choices.feedback: Sounding the horn is not a substitute for stopping for this school bus.
